courses.title: Theory and Technique of Ballet I
courses.description: This course is an introduction to the study and practice of the discipline and creative art of classical ballet, focusing on the development of basic movement theory and techniques, including ballet barre and basic center floor exercises.

courses.title: Theory and Technique of Hip-Hop I (Popular American Dance)
courses.description: This course is an introduction to the discipline of creative arts through hip-hop dance with an integrated fitness approach that focuses on developing the stabilization muscles in the center of the body. Students will concentrate on muscles of the torso, back, hips, inner and outer thighs, while the chest and abdominals will be used in conjunction with breathing, posture, and muscle awareness. Students will also be exposed to the great works and artists in the field and develop a working hip-hop dance vocabulary, as the course explores the theory and practice of basic hip-hop techniques.

courses.title: Theory and Technique of Social Dance I
courses.description: This course is one of three that introduces students to the discipline and creative art of social dance. It focuses on developing a working vocabulary of the traditional social dance movements of the Fox Trot, Waltz, Cha-Cha-Cha, Nite Club 2-Step, and the Hustle. Also, the course covers the cultural and historical contexts that produced these specific dances.

metadata.Course Description: This is an intermediate course that builds on basic creative art skills and exposes students to intermediate forms of social dance in a salsa dance context. courses.title: Theory and Technique of Jazz Dance I
courses.description: This dance course introduces the discipline and creative art of jazz dance, focusing on basic principles of technique, theory, practice, conditioning, development of a working vocabulary, and exposure to the history of major American jazz artists, and their works.

courses.title: Theory and Technique of Jazz Dance II
courses.description: This dance course continues the study and practice of the discipline and creative art of jazz dance. Focus will be on the elementary principles of technique, theory, practice, and conditioning (to increase functional range of motion and core muscular strength) at an elementary level, along with exploring the choreographic elements of time, space and energy, in addition to exposure to the history of major international influences, jazz dance artists, and their works.

courses.title: Body Awareness and Conditioning for Dancers
courses.description: This course will teach students the principles of dance and conditioning through floor work derived from ballet, contemporary dance, and other psycho-physical disciplines. Topics may include body mechanics, muscle groups critical to dance, flexibility, alignment, self-assessment, dance injury prevention, and strengthening the mind-body connection.
